Thirty-two residents still live at the abandoned freight yard. The repair shed can smelt scrap from the wreckage into iron, but it lacks a steady supply of rations and coal.
The freight yard's guards require a reciprocal goods manifest first. No jobs may be assigned to local residents without their approval.
Eighteen residents are living off the water purification pond, eight of them visibly mutated. Medical staff and teachers are still making do with old prewar textbooks.
They are willing to trade medicine and handwritten books, but have made one demand clear: everyone on the road must be treated as an equal resident.

Citizenship applies equally to ordinary people and mutated residents. Rations, basic medical care, and protection must not be denied based on appearance.

“Equal citizenship” grants the right to representation immediately; “Residency status” converts to full status after 600 seconds of continuous registration; “Tiered status” maintains an affiliated subordinate relationship only and cannot achieve equal integration.
You can spend 30 knowledge at the council hall later to reconsider eligibility. Changes to the system will not reset local storage or clear public supplies already allocated.
